name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Onboarding & Candidate Experience | Workflow Coordination, Documentation Accuracy, Stakeholder Communication
summary: Onboarding specialist with 15+ years in client-facing roles, including two years leading onboarding teams at Wix and helping hire, onboard, and train new team members. Manages high-volume onboarding (25+ per month, ~25 in flight at peak) without dropping steps, keeps records audit-ready, and builds the reminders and workflows that track every requirement to completion.

Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable in GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, keeping records auditable across concurrent engagements.
Build automated workflows that send confirmations, reminders, and follow-ups by email and SMS, so no required step stalls waiting on a manual nudge.

Built communication workflows and automated training sequences that reduced onboarding friction for partners and their customers.
